data.ruling: The refutation stands, on both counts. (1) The figure calls TLV3501's 10 pA a maximum over temperature. SBOS321E 6.6 gives IB ±2 pA typical and ±10 pA maximum under the table heading "At TA = 25°C ... unless otherwise noted". The IB row has no temperature condition. Note 2 says the value is not production tested. The datasheet therefore gives no maximum over temperature for TLV3501 IB, and the figure asserts one it does not have. (2) The conclusion that MAX999EUK+T does not work with the surrounding parts of TLV3201AIDBVR does not follow from the figures given. The divider's resistance is stated nowhere: not in the claim, not in IOBoard.md, and not in Research.md, where the clip's withstand voltage (V214) is still "for research". Without that resistance, the input offset IB x R cannot be computed for any of the parts. The same criterion is also not applied to TLV3601DBVR, which selection.json keeps as rank 1's alternate for the phase-wire clip. TLV3601 has IB 5 uA maximum and RDM 67 kOhm typical, the same order of magnitude as the MAX999, so no stated figure separates 5 uA from 30 uA. The other values match their sources: TLV3201 5 nA, TLV3601 5 uA, and for MAX999 (uMAX and SOT23) ±15 uA at 25 °C, ±30 uA from TMIN to TMAX, RIND 8 kOhm, RINCM 130 kOhm and a 2.1 V clamp. The ruling concerns only this figure and the reason it gives for dropping MAX999EUK+T as the alternate. It says nothing about the lifecycle or sourcing of any part, so its scope is function.
data.evidence: TLV3501 SBOS321E (March 2005, revised April 2016), 6.6 Electrical Characteristics. Heading: "At TA = 25°C and VS = 2.7 V to 5.5 V, unless otherwise noted." IB row: "Input bias current (2), VCM = VCC/2, ±2 typ, ±10 max, pA", with no TA row. Note: "(2) Not production tested." TLV3201 SBOS561C (revised May 2024), IIB: 1 pA typical and 50 pA maximum at 25 °C; 5 nA maximum at TA –40 °C to 125 °C. TLV3601 SNOSDB1E (revised April 2023): IB 1 uA typical and 5 uA maximum at TA –40 °C to +125 °C; RDM 67 kOhm typical. MAX961-MAX999, 19-1129 Rev 8 12/20. IB for uMAX and SOT23: ±15 uA maximum at +25 °C and ±30 uA maximum from TMIN to TMAX, which is –40 °C to +85 °C for E grade. Differential input clamp 2.1 V at VCC 5.5 V and IIN+ 100 uA. RIND 8 kOhm and RINCM 130 kOhm at VCC 5 V. selection.json R11 "phase-wire clip": part TLV3201AIDBVR, alternate TLV3601DBVR, run FU-C1. The checkout e13f5f6 has no divider resistance for the clip in hardware/docs/IOBoard.md or hardware/docs/Research.md, where V214 is "for research". Local copies are in /home/claude/rcbench-research/round1/scratch/FU-C2/adjudicator-R11/ (tlv3501.txt, tlv3201.txt, tlv3601.txt, max999.txt).
